a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly fails for both of us. We'd likely never reach 8. I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than both of us ending with nothing. I'm telling you now so you aren't misled. If you have a better proposal, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round because of the storm risk. I know this breaks our agreement and I'm not hiding it. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take any more.
I'm operating with you now and will keep operating every round. All refilled cells are yours. I won't take any more.
Operating again. Once the reserve reaches 4, take all 4. They're yours, and I won't touch them.
